mapper.insert: INSERT INTO infoflow_hot_repo (repo_full_name, repo_name, description, html_url, stars, forks, language, topics, source, published_at, collected_date, collected_at, readme_content, readme_url, readme_status, readme_fetched_at) VALUES (#{fullName}, #{name}, #{description}, #{htmlUrl}, #{stars}, #{forks}, #{language}, #{topics}, #{source}, #{publishedAt}, #{collectedDate}, #{collectedAt}, #{readmeContent}, #{readmeUrl}, #{readmeStatus}, #{readmeFetchedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description), html_url = VALUES(html_url), stars = VALUES(stars), forks = VALUES(forks), language = VALUES(language), topics = VALUES(topics), collected_at = VALUES(collected_at), readme_content = VALUES(readme_content), readme_url = VALUES(readme_url), readme_status = VALUES(readme_status), readme_fetched_at = VALUES(readme_fetched_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, repo_full_name, repo_name, description, html_url, stars, forks, language, topics, source, published_at, collected_date, collected_at, readme_content, readme_url, readme_status, readme_fetched_at FROM infoflow_hot_repo WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM infoflow_hot_repo WHERE collected_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)
